title: High-use shadcn primitives
lede: Shared field, overlay, menu, table, and toggle primitives now share press/focus chrome, 40px compact hit areas, origin-aware menus, and sentence-case table headers.

stats.n: Authenticated /items in Cursor Chromium, 1372×1160, dark, ADMIN.
Table headers dropped forced uppercase. STATUS is now Status.
Add Item sheet close measured 40×40 CSS pixels after the pass.

sections.heading: Items list
sections.note: Matched Cursor IDE Chromium captures at 1372×1160 CSS pixels, ADMIN, dark appearance, authenticated local Preview at 127.0.0.1:3000. HEAD f7733f57. After photos finished loading; the before capture raced item-image decode, so thumbnails are not part of the claimed change.

pairs.title: Inventory table
pairs.sub: Buttons, badges, search, checkboxes, and table headers.
pairs.beforeCap: STATUS was forced uppercase by the shared TableHead class while Name, Category, Department, and Location stayed sentence case from sort buttons.
pairs.afterCap: Status is sentence case with the other headers. Search, segmented All/Standard/Units/Quantity, badges, and row checkboxes keep the same layout.

changes.was: Input, Textarea, NativeSelect, and SelectTrigger used near-copies of focus/invalid styles with drifting transitions and disabled treatment.
changes.now: Shared fieldChrome covers hover, focus, invalid, and disabled states so a text field and a select in the same row match.

changes.was: Buttons already scaled on press. Duration, cursor, and reduced-motion were inconsistent across toggles, menus, and overlays.
changes.now: Buttons, toggles, and overlay close controls use a 150ms press scale, 40px close targets, and motion-reduce safety. Menus and selects open from their trigger origin.

changes.h: Compact controls keep a 40px hit area
changes.was: Checkbox, radio, and switch visuals were 16–20px with no expanded hit target.
changes.now: They keep their compact visuals and expand to a 40px hit area. Switch is a slightly larger 24×44 track. Form fields stay h-9 until a dedicated field-baseline slice.

changes.was: TableHead forced uppercase tracking-wider, so some headers shouted (STATUS) next to sentence-case sort labels.
changes.now: Headers are sentence case and medium weight, matching the design-language table rule.

changes.was: Dialog titles could sit under the close control. Sheets opened over 500ms. Tooltips always waited 200ms.
changes.now: Dialogs cap height and pad titles away from the 40px close control. Sheets open in 300ms. After the first tooltip, the next one skips delay.

verification.name: Lint / whitespace
verification.detail: eslint on changed primitive files; git diff --check on primitives, DESIGN_LANGUAGE, and the new test.

verification.name: Authenticated browser
verification.detail: ADMIN session on 127.0.0.1:3000/items. Keyboard/CDP: table header text-transform none; sheet close 40×40; field chrome transition includes border-color and background-color. Next.js overlay showed a one-time HMR hydration mismatch on TooltipProvider skipDelayDuration after live reload; a full navigation cleared the list.

verification.name: build:app
verification.detail: Not run. scripts/guard-next-build.mjs refuses a Next build while 127.0.0.1:3000 is in use, and that server was kept running for the authenticated captures.

notes: Default Button and Input heights stay h-9. Raising the form-field baseline to 40px is still its own slice.
Icon-sm / icon-xs and dense row icons remain the documented density exception.
Add Item sheet close was measured at 40×40 after the pass; the after sheet screenshot did not keep the panel in frame, so that overlay is CDP proof rather than a matched pair.
